candidates: When documenting a feature that supports multiple modes or options, begin the section with an introductory summary that lists all supported modes (including their syntax keywords and which is the default) before branching into per-mode subsections or details.

When writing documentation for a visual layout or orientation mode, describe the concrete visual behavior of each mode explicitly — state how primary content elements (e.g., commits) flow directionally and how structural elements (e.g., branches) are arranged relative to each other — rather than relying on abstract directional labels alone.
Contributors should not self-resolve review conversation threads after addressing feedback; leave threads open so the reviewer can verify the fix and close them during re-review.
